name: Jose Aldo

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (67 in height, 70 in reach, born 1986-09-09, last fight 2025-05-10); fight weight = bantamweight limit 135 lb (his last fights were at bantamweight)

photo_coverage: Good for face and body, but the newest photos are from May 2025 (UFC 315, his last fight; Cageside Press reported he retired after it), so nothing from 2026. Official studio headshot and two full-body cut-outs, two UFC 315 weigh-in photos (frontal pose and three-quarter right), three freely licensed Commons photos (two from March 2015 with a buzz cut and stubble, CC BY-SA 2.0, which show the cheek scar best; one smiling three-quarter, CC BY-SA 4.0, dated 2017 on Commons but probably 2019 or later) and a 2021 fight photo. Nine files because the 2015 Commons pair is the only freely licensed frontal view.

face.shape: Inverted-triangle face: broad across the temples and cheekbones, tapering to a narrow, pointed chin. Lean, with hollow cheeks under prominent cheekbones; the shaved head makes the skull outline part of the look.
face.jaw: Narrow-to-medium and well defined, angling quickly toward the chin.
face.chin: Narrow and pointed with moderate projection; the goatee lengthens it by about 1-2 cm.
face.cheekbones: High, prominent and wide; strong hollows beneath, deeper with age (2025 vs 2015).
face.brow_ridge: Fairly strong; the eyes sit deep under it.
face.forehead: Broad and slightly sloping; continuous with the shaved scalp, which has a rounded, fairly high crown.

eyes.shape: Medium-large, round-almond, deep-set, with heavy lower-lid creases and tear-trough hollows that curve down onto the cheek (much stronger in 2025 than in 2015); upper lids slightly hooded, often half-lidded at rest.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest MakeHuman iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight with a soft arch toward the outer third, sitting close over the eyes.
eyebrows.colour: Black-brown (patch sample #6a362b includes skin; render near #231816)

nose.width: Broad at the tip and nostrils; bridge medium-broad
nose.bridge: Low-to-moderate, slightly flattened; straight in the 2015 frontal photos
nose.tip: Rounded, fleshy, slightly broad; nostrils flare a little
nose.fight_damage: Mild flattening/widening possible; no clear deviation.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; medium upper lip, fuller lower lip. Neutral, slightly pursed resting mouth; big open smile showing upper teeth that pushes the cheeks into round apples (Commons smiling photo).

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, moderate on both ears: thickened upper ear with filled-in, lumpy folds (studio headshot, UFC 315 three-quarter photo).

face.marks_scars: Smooth, lighter, slightly shiny scar band on his left lower cheek and jaw, running from the left mouth corner down and back toward the jawline (clearest in both 2015 Commons photos; visible as a pale patch beside the goatee in the studio headshot). A short curved crease or scar under the right eye on the right cheek (studio headshot).

hair.style: Shaved head (razor or very close clipper) in recent years; a faint stubble shadow shows at the sides and back. In 2015 he wore a short buzz cut (about 3 mm).
hair.colour_note: No head hair to sample in recent photos (scalp patch in the studio headshot reads #f09a78, i.e. skin). The 2015 buzz cut and the beard are black; use #1c1514 for any stubble shadow at low opacity.
hair.hairline: From the 2015 buzz cut: normal height with slight temple recession; irrelevant while shaved.
hair.texture: Shaved; the 2015 buzz cut looked dense and dark.

facial_hair.colour_note: Black with a few grey hairs in the chin beard; patch samples include skin between hairs, so render darker than the samples.
facial_hair.density: Moustache: thin but dense line. Chin beard: dense on the chin, a thin soul-patch strip connects the lower lip to the chin; cheeks and jaw clean-shaven.
facial_hair.shape: Thin pencil moustache following the upper-lip line and dipping slightly at the corners, plus a short chin beard (goatee) about 1-2 cm, rounded-pointed, with a narrow soul-patch line. Same style 2019-2025; in 2015 only stubble.

skin.tone_hex_method: Plain RGB mean of the studio-lit cheek samples marked in_average (two photos); the specular forehead, a shadowed cheek, the yellow venue light at UFC 315, the warm stage light in 2015 and the phone flash in the smiling photo are reported but excluded. Each sample is the mean of the 15th-85th luma-percentile pixels of the patch.
skin.tone_note: Medium tan-brown with a reddish-golden warmth; in the same studio light his face reads deeper and more saturated than Song Yadong's or Mario Bautista's.
skin.freckles_marks: Light dark hair on the chest and a line down the abdomen; hair on forearms and legs. Facial scars as in face.marks_scars.

body.build: Compact, muscular and very lean 170 cm frame; dense and powerful rather than long.
body.body_fat_note: Full abs, obliques and serratus visible in the studio cut-outs and at the May 2025 weigh-in at 135 lb.
body.shoulders: Broad for his height, round full deltoids, visible upper trapezius.
body.chest: Full, thick, well-defined pectorals; light chest hair.
body.arms: Muscular with large biceps and strong forearms; reach (178 cm) about 7.5 cm longer than his height, so arms look long for his frame.
body.legs_calves: Very muscular thighs with clear quadriceps separation above the knee; strong calves.
body.posture: Upright, chest open and shoulders square; head level with a slightly raised chin. Arms hang close with a slight bend in the studio shots.
body.notable: Strongest cues: shaved head, deep-set eyes with heavy under-eye creases, broad cheekbones narrowing to a pointed goatee, thin moustache, cauliflower ears, the scar on the left lower cheek, the right-arm sleeve and left-shoulder cross tattoo, and a compact, muscular frame.

stance_and_guard.observed: 2021 fight photo: right hand thrown long and straight from an upright torso, left hand dropped to hip height as it comes back. Studio: square, upright stance, arms hanging close with a slight bend.
stance_and_guard.animation_hint: Upright orthodox stance with a square, proud posture; let the hands sit a little lower than a high shell guard. Only one fight photo, so treat guard height as low confidence.

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey realism: lion head on the shoulder and outer upper arm, a lioness and cub on the upper arm, a clock or pocket-watch face on the forearm, with smoke-like shading filling between images.
Black-and-grey cross rising from a rounded cluster (stone- or cloud-like shapes) inside an oval rope-like frame, with a banner below containing Japanese katakana-style characters.

tattoos.where: Chest, torso, left arm below the shoulder, legs

kit.fight_shorts_recent: Blue UFC Venum kits in both studio cut-outs (blue with white slash stripes and crypto.com; older blue kit with darker pattern and a yellow tab). UFC 315 (May 2025) weigh-in: olive-brown shorts with yellow trim. 2021: yellow Venum kit with ALDO lettering.
kit.weigh_in_media: Silver chain with a cross pendant and a red wristband at the UFC 315 weigh-in; brown UFC/Venum jacket at media day.

morphs_height_note: macro/heightDownM 0.19 from the research/assets.md male fit heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 with H = 1.702 m; drop it if the avatar code scales to the tale of the tape directly. ageOldM = (40 - 25) / 65. His reach is 7.6 cm over his height: if the rig supports arm length, lengthen arms slightly. The under-eye creases and the cheek scar are better in the normal map or a skin overlay than in shape morphs.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets are not in assets/embed/mh-manifest.json. If added: ears/l-ear-scale-incr and ears/r-ear-scale-incr about 0.15, ears/l-ear-rot-forward and ears/r-ear-rot-forward about 0.2, plus a thickened-helix normal map on both ears (moderate cauliflower).

render_hints.skin_base: mh-skin-middleage_caucasian_male (adds age lines) tinted toward #ce8066, with a smooth, lighter, slightly glossy scar patch on the left lower cheek and jaw from the mouth corner toward the jawline
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow001 tinted #231816, medium thickness, soft arch
render_hints.hair: no hair proxy; very faint stubble shadow on the back and sides of the scalp
render_hints.beard: thin moustache line plus short chin goatee with a narrow soul patch, #231816 with a few grey hairs; cheeks clean

notes: Confidence: high for head, facial hair, eyes, scar location, tattoos and build (clear studio photos, May 2025 weigh-in photos and freely licensed photos from 2015 and about 2019). Lower for anything after May 2025: there are no 2026 photos (he has not fought since UFC 315), so facial hair or weight may have changed. Skin tone varies a lot with lighting across these photos; the studio-based average is the most consistent. Watch for: (1) shaved head with deep-set eyes and heavy under-eye creases at 40; (2) broad cheekbones tapering to a narrow chin with a short goatee and thin moustache; (3) cauliflower ears that stick out; (4) the pale scar on the left lower cheek/jaw; (5) right-arm sleeve and the cross on the left shoulder; (6) compact, muscular 170 cm frame with big thighs.
